# Mohammad Raihanul Bashar - Comprehensive Research & Academic Portfolio

> Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Extended Reality (XR/VR/AR), Eye-Tracking, Biosignal Processing (EEG/EMG), and Biorobotics Ph.D. Researcher at Concordia University.

---

## Biography & Academic Profile
Mohammad Raihanul Bashar is a Ph.D. researcher at Concordia University, Montreal, Canada. His research spans Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Spatial User Interfaces (SUI), Extended Reality (XR/VR/AR), Eye-Tracking, Biosignal Processing (EEG/EMG), and Biorobotics. He focuses on designing, modeling, and evaluating 3D interaction techniques, gaze-contingent interfaces, vergence-accommodation conflict dynamics, and biosignal noise reduction for virtual environments.

### Core Research Areas:
1. **Spatial User Interfaces & XR**: 3D selection, spatial sketching in VR (Depth3DSketch), vergence-accommodation conflict (VAC) modeling, and virtual task environment design.
2. **Eye-Tracking & Gaze Interaction**: Multi-threshold dwell time selection, spontaneous blinking ocular biometric authentication, and gaze-contingent rendering.
3. **Biosignals & Neuromarketing**: EEG artifact removal algorithms, EMG video classification, and computational intelligence for physiological sensing.
4. **Biorobotics & Computer Vision**: Stereo humanoid vision systems and autonomous landmine detection via surface mapping.

---

## Interactive Research Evaluation Tools
Mohammad Raihanul Bashar has authored a suite of web-based empirical evaluation tools designed for HCI, XR, and ergonomics researchers:

### 1. NASA Task Load Index (NASA-TLX & S-TLX)
- URL: https://mbraihan.github.io/tools/nasa-tlx
- Description: Subjective workload assessment instrument. Supports Raw NASA-TLX (R-TLX), Weighted NASA-TLX (15 pairwise comparisons), and Shortened NASA-TLX (S-TLX: Mental, Physical, Performance). Supports 0–100 continuous and 0–20 discrete scale ranges, normalized Participant IDs (P01), and multi-row Google Sheets / CSV data logging.

### 2. System Usability Scale (SUS)
- URL: https://mbraihan.github.io/tools/sus
- Description: 10-item usability evaluation questionnaire. Provides instant overall SUS score calculation (0–100), percentile ranking, Sauro-Lewis letter grading (A+ to F), normalized Participant IDs (P01), and multi-row Google Sheets / CSV data logging.

### 3. User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ & UEQ-S)
- URL: https://mbraihan.github.io/tools/ueq
- Description: Bipolar rating scale evaluating 6 UX dimensions (Attractiveness, Perspicuity, Efficiency, Dependability, Stimulation, Novelty) in full 26-item version and 8-item UEQ-S version. Outputs -3 to +3 transformed scale averages and 5-column CSV / Google Sheets logs.

### 4. Igroup Presence Questionnaire (IPQ)
- URL: https://mbraihan.github.io/tools/ipq
- Description: 14-item questionnaire assessing Spatial Presence (SP), Involvement (INV), Experienced Realism (REAL), and General Presence (G1) in Virtual Reality and Extended Reality environments.

### 5. Simulator Sickness Questionnaire (SSQ)
- URL: https://mbraihan.github.io/tools/ssq
- Description: 16-symptom questionnaire calculating Kennedy et al. (1993) weighted subscores for Nausea, Oculomotor Discomfort, Disorientation, and Total Simulator Sickness.

### 6. Borg CR-10 Perceived Exertion Scale
- URL: https://mbraihan.github.io/tools/borg
- Description: 11-point Category-Ratio scale evaluating physical effort and fatigue dynamics across task phases (Before Task, During Task, After Task) with peak exertion tracking.

### 7. Experimental Counterbalancing Generator
- URL: https://mbraihan.github.io/tools/counterbalancing
- Description: Automated experimental design generator supporting Williams Latin Squares, Complete Latin Squares, Blocked Nested Factorial Counterbalancing, and Random Order matrices with wide table export.

### 8. HCI & XR Conference Deadline Tracker
- URL: https://mbraihan.github.io/tools/conference-tracker
- Description: Real-time deadline, venue, location, ICORE ranking (A*, A, B), and countdown tracker for top HCI/XR conferences (CHI, IEEE VR, ISMAR, UIST, DIS, TEI, ETRA, VRST, ICMI, CSCW, UbiComp).

---

## Selected Publications
1. **Eyes on Many: Multi-Target Gaze Selection**  
   - Topic: Multi-target selection and dwell thresholds in gaze-controlled interfaces.  
   - Link: https://mbraihan.github.io/publications/eyes-on-many

2. **Effects of Visual Depth on Vergence-Accommodation Conflict**  
   - Topic: Empirical analysis of visual depth cues and VAC in stereoscopic HMDs.  
   - Link: https://mbraihan.github.io/publications/effects-visual-depth-vac

3. **Depth3DSketch: Spatial 3D Sketching in Virtual Reality**  
   - Topic: Spatial 3D input techniques and 3D curve manipulation in VR.  
   - Link: https://mbraihan.github.io/publications/depth3dsketch

4. **Spontaneous Blinking Authentication**  
   - Topic: Ocular biometric authentication using spontaneous eyeblink dynamics.  
   - Link: https://mbraihan.github.io/publications/spontaneous-blinking-authentication

5. **EEG Artifact Removal in Biorobotics & Neuromarketing**  
   - Topic: Signal processing algorithms for EEG noise reduction in physiological sensing.  
   - Link: https://mbraihan.github.io/publications/artefact-removal-eeg
